hypothesis: The fixed lean v30 composition may retain its opened historical and concurrent mark-to-market advantage when evaluated against exact prospective route evidence emitted by the running v25 backend.
decision: Retain the exact v30 bytes as an inactive canary candidate, but lower immediate activation confidence from low-medium to low. At this frozen prefix, ETH and SOL Range Onset each have 1,922 forward evaluations but zero eligible signals or exact closes; SPCX Swing has 21 eligible paths with negative mean direction at every reported horizon and two long closes totaling +$0.910830, but becomes -$0.656872 after removing its only winner. Keep v25 unchanged while six venue-stopped positions remain open. Continue exact route collection without increasing leverage, notional, slots, routes, or adding an ML/regime gate. This is a recommendation rather than a hidden performance gate: a future v30 canary still requires explicit operator authority and the existing flat-and-order-free transition contract.
falsifier: The revision is invalidated if its checkpoint or decisions prefix cannot be reproduced, a selected provider-symbol route was substituted, eligible paths were represented as fills, future evidence entered an earlier decision, open positions or venue stops were omitted, or candidate bytes changed. Independent after-cost ETH and SOL outcomes on both sides and SPCX profitability excluding its largest winner would raise confidence; continued negative eligible paths, adverse route closes, or worse live friction would lower it.
limitations: ETH and SOL have no eligible forward signal or exact live close in this prefix.
SPCX exact execution contains only two long closes and depends on one winner.
Eligible directional paths are not fills and do not include private queue or acknowledgement behavior.
